description: Hide a post from the user's Chirpie listings. NOTHING REACHES THE PLATFORM: the post stays exactly as it is, keeps its analytics and its comments, and chirpie_unhide_post puts it back. Nothing is charged and no quota moves. Hiding changes only what Chirpie shows; chirpie_delete_post is what takes a post down from the platform. A hidden post is left out of chirpie_list_posts unless include_hidden is true, and is always readable by id with chirpie_get_post. HIDING A QUEUED POST DOES NOT STOP IT PUBLISHING: the scheduler pays no attention to it, and chirpie_delete_post is what stops a scheduled post going out. A thread, or a fan-out made in one request, is hidden as the one thing it was made as, so `hidden_ids` in the answer can name more posts than the id you passed.

id.description: Post ID to hide. A thread or fan-out moves whole.

name: chirpie_hide_post
title: Hide a post in Chirpie
